summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on 29 September 2026, attaching a press release covering its Capital Markets Day held in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Named executives, led by CEO Tadeu Marroco, presented Horizon 2030 strategy, mid-teens New Category revenue growth, at least 30% segment contribution margin by 2030, and reaffirmed FY26 guidance of 3-5% revenue and 4-6% adjusted operating profit growth, with adjusted diluted EPS toward the middle of 5-8%, plus a 2-2.5% FX headwind. No transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, no special-situation mechanics.
